name: memory
description: reddb.io memory plugin - persistent, queryable memory for code agents that lives on top of dev. Markdown-only slice: memory init, /memory:store, /memory:recall over plain markdown notes. Requires the dev plugin.

interface.longDescription: RedSkills Memory gives code agents a persistent, queryable memory that survives /clear and crosses sessions. This release ships the markdown-only path — a single init wizard plus /memory:store and /memory:recall over plain markdown notes, with no engine dependency. Builds on the dev plugin's processes.
defaultPrompt: Run $init to set up markdown-only memory.
Look up what we know with $recall.
